thread:
ashley: Heads-up — competitor rolled out a near-parity per-route SLO control in self-serve. They claim per-route SLOs + automatic fallback. Need a product decision: rush parity or double-down on our cost-aware routing differentiator? Acme pilot is asking for per-route guarantees.

mike: TL;DR from sales: this is a blockers for a mid-market deal. We need a scoped MVP that we can ship in ~3 sprints. Options: (A) parity — per-route SLOs + API + console; (B) differentiate — tenant-level cost controls, better fallback policies, and observability. Tradeoffs?

devon: From CS: Acme explicitly asked for per-route SLOs and will push contract timeline if we don't offer something. But they'd accept a beta with clear caveats (no hard SLA, pilot terms).

jia: Eng: per-route SLOs touch routing and the policy layer. Full parity (enforceable SLOs + canary routing + tracing) is heavy. MVP that is sensible: enforceable soft limits, automatic fallback to lower-tier model, and per-route metrics. Estimated 6-8 weeks with two engs + infra support.

sam: Design: UI is straightforward for an MVP — a compact per-route settings panel and a clear error/soft-fail UX. I can mock a beta flow in ~5 business days. Need product to define error messaging and opt-in language.

mike: Proposed path: short-term (beta): expose API knobs for per-route targets, label as beta and require pilot opt-in (no console). Medium-term: console controls + rollout rules in Q3. Can we commit to API-only beta to hit Acme?

devon: Sales wants a pricing add-on + pilot SLA language. They can sign LOI if we can commit to a 6-8 week delivery and provide weekly status.

jia: If we commit, recommend scope cuts: skip canary-weight routing and full distributed tracing for the beta. Focus on enforcement, metrics, and rollback controls. We'll need a feature flag and migration notes.

ashley: Agree with scope cut. Go/no-go criteria we should lock into the PRD: (1) Enforcement works for hosted and dedicated; (2) Telemetry shows <=2% p50 regression vs baseline; (3) Pilot customer signed LOI. If any fail, pull the beta.

mike: I'll draft PRD with those launch criteria. @sam start mocks, @jia kick off an engineering spike, @devon secure a pilot LOI.

product-bot: New PRD created: https://confluence.internal/redwood/prd/per-route-slos-beta (placeholder)

sam: Will drop first mock screenshots to #design-samples in ~48h. :thumbsup:

jia: Spike ticket created: INF-4921. I posted a rough estimate and the dependencies (routing policy, feature flag, telemetry). @lex @nora please review.

lex: Reviewing the spike — early note: we can reuse parts of the KV cache routing hooks but need infra sign-off for the enforcement path.

nora: Ack. I'll run a perf baseline and confirm infra constraints by EOD tomorrow.

mike: Thanks. Let's sync at the weekly triage tomorrow 10am. If you're blocked, drop notes here.
file_notes: Beta-scope negotiation for per-route SLOs vs differentiation; includes PRD creation, spike ticket, and pilot ask.
